_description: Full suite: baselines, classic optimizer signals, BL, ML feature-set and model comparisons, long/short, and stat arb. Long-only optimizer strategies share one universe and one constraint set so differences come from the signal. Also folds in every standalone non-ETF experiment (_source on each strategy names its original config); those keep their own universes and settings, so they are not held to the shared-universe/constraint convention above.

strategies.name: equal_weight_securities
strategies._note: 1/N over the same universe as the long-only optimizer strategies. The survivorship-bias control: anything that can't beat this isn't adding value.

strategies.name: fixed_weight_multi_asset_1_5x
strategies._note: Same weights at 1.5x leverage, rebalanced weekly back to target. Borrowing at risk_free_rate + financing_spread.

strategies.name: mean_variance
strategies._note: Historical mean returns. The no-signal optimizer baseline.

strategies.name: momentum
strategies._note: 12-1 price momentum: 1y lookback, skipping the most recent 21 trading days.

strategies.name: mean_reversion
strategies._note: Short-term reversal: ranks the trailing 21-day return, losers favored.

strategies.name: ml_momentum_features
strategies._note: ML scores used directly as expected returns. 12-feature set including mom_1m / mom_12m.

strategies.name: ml_bl_momentum
strategies._note: Same ML model feeding BL views, momentum view direction.

strategies.name: ml_reversal_features
strategies._note: ML scores used directly. 7-feature ablation set (momentum features removed).

strategies.name: ml_bl_mean_reversion
strategies._note: 7-feature ML feeding BL, mean-reversion view.

strategies.name: ml_gbr_bl_mean_reversion
strategies._note: Identical to ml_bl_mean_reversion except the model: gradient boosting vs Ridge.

strategies.name: ls_130_30_ml_bl
strategies._note: max_long 1.30 / max_short 0.30: gross 1.60, net 1.00. Sector bounds are net.

strategies.name: ls_market_neutral_ml
strategies._note: max_long 1.00 / max_short 1.00: gross 2.00, net 0.00. Sector bounds are net and centered on zero.

strategies.name: pairs_trading
strategies._note: Within-sector cointegrated pairs, z-score entry/exit/stop. Slowest strategy in the suite.

strategies.name: fixed_weight_securities
strategies._note: Static 1/N target weights over the same universe, rebalanced weekly back to target. Matches equal_weight_securities while the universe is fixed; edit initial_weights to test a tilted static allocation.

strategies.name: inverse_vol_garch
strategies._description: 1/sigma with a GARCH(1,1) forecast fitted on the 1y lookback.

strategies.name: inverse_vol_equal_weight_baseline
strategies._description: Equal weight across the same 11 ETFs, rebalanced monthly. The bar inverse vol has to beat.

strategies.name: ls_130_30_ml
strategies._note: max_long 1.30 / max_short 0.30 => gross 1.60, net 1.00. Sector bounds are NET exposures.

strategies.name: ls_market_neutral_ml_tight
strategies._note: max_long 1.00 / max_short 1.00 => gross 2.00, net 0.00. No BL overlay: the BL equilibrium prior is built from long-only market-cap reference weights and fights a net-zero book. Sector bounds are NET and centered on zero.

strategies.name: mean_variance_tax_aware
strategies._note: Identical to mean_variance except apply_tax_objective=true: the optimizer penalises realising gains (37% short-term / 20% long-term). Reported returns are still pre-tax, so compare turnover and holding periods, not returns alone.
